claims.answer: Crush embeds its own agent loop (via the fantasy provider layer) rather than launching other agent CLIs. Model providers are broad: Hyper, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, OpenRouter, Groq, xAI and others plus custom OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoints and local servers. Mixed-harness operation does not exist; subagents can use a different model but not a different harness.

sources.title: Crush README
sources.locator: Features, Installation, Getting Started, API Keys, Configuration, MCPs, Hooks, Sharing a workspace, Skills, Metrics sections
sources.finding: Terminal coding agent: multi-model (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible and many named providers), mid-session model switching, per-project sessions, LSP context, MCP (http/stdio/sse), macOS/Linux/Windows/Android/BSD terminals; crushrc config; permissions allow/deny and --yolo; Agent Skills; pseudonymous metrics with CRUSH_DISABLE_METRICS/DO_NOT_TRACK opt-out; Hyper first-party model provider; FSL-1.1-MIT license.

sources.title: LICENSE.md (FSL-1.1-MIT)
sources.locator: LICENSE.md: Abbreviation, License Grant, Permitted Purpose, Future License
sources.finding: Functional Source License 1.1 with MIT Future License: use, copy, modify and redistribute for any Permitted Purpose except a Competing Use; each version converts to MIT after the stated period. Source-available, not a standard OSI license today.

sources.title: AGENTS.md development guide
sources.finding: Package map: app wiring, cmd, config, agent (SessionAgent, coordinator), hooks, session (SQLite), lsp, ui (Bubble Tea v2), permission, skills, shell, event (PostHog), pubsub; context files AGENTS.md/CRUSH.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md read from the working directory.

sources.title: Config JSON schema
sources.locator: schema.json $defs Options, Permissions, MCPConfig, SelectedModel, Pricing
sources.finding: Options include request_timeout, max_background_jobs, disable_auto_summarize, disable_metrics, disabled_tools, attribution, notifications, context_paths, skills_paths; MCP config includes channel_enabled and oauth; no budget, turn or spend-limit option.

sources.title: CLI root command and metrics gate
sources.locator: internal/cmd/root.go (command registration; CRUSH_DISABLE_METRICS and DO_NOT_TRACK checks near line 984)
sources.finding: Registered commands: run, server, login, logout, logs, models, projects, session (list/show/last/delete/rename), stats, dirs, schema, update-providers. No scheduler, issue, export or MCP-serve command. Metrics disabled by CRUSH_DISABLE_METRICS or DO_NOT_TRACK.

sources.title: crush login command
sources.locator: internal/cmd/login.go Long help and platform switch
sources.finding: Login platforms: hyper, copilot (github-copilot), openai/chatgpt, grok (xai). No Claude subscription login.

sources.title: ChatGPT OAuth against the Codex backend
sources.finding: PKCE browser flow lets a ChatGPT account use its subscription through chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex (same flow as Codex CLI).

sources.title: Grok/xAI OAuth
sources.finding: Sign in with the Grok account its subscription is attached to; access token is a Bearer credential for api.x.ai/v1.

sources.title: GitHub Copilot device-flow login
sources.finding: GitHub device-code flow exchanged for a Copilot token via api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token; subscription reuse.

sources.title: crush server command
sources.finding: crush server serves the HTTP API over unix socket (default), tcp or http host; OpenAPI 3.1 docs at /v1/docs/; SIGHUP reloads config.

sources.title: Server construction and handler
sources.finding: Plain http.ServeMux over unix or tcp listener with recover and logging middleware; no authentication or TLS middleware in the handler chain (search terms: authorization, bearer, token, password in internal/server).

sources.title: Server HTTP endpoint table
sources.finding: Endpoints for workspaces, sessions, messages, agent run/cancel/queue/summarize/shell, permissions grant and mode, questions, MCP state and auth, LSP, config, skills, events (SSE), git branch.

sources.title: crush run non-interactive command
sources.finding: Single prompt headless run from args or stdin with --model, --small-model, --reasoning-effort, --session, --continue, --quiet, --verbose; attaches to a running server when one exists.

sources.title: agent_dispatch subagent tools
sources.finding: agent_dispatch starts a detached subagent with label, read/write access and optional model/provider/reasoning override; agent_send follows up or reopens; agent_stop stops; reports arrive as later turns.

sources.title: agent_dispatch tool description
sources.finding: Subagent reports back as a <subagent-report>; agent_status/agent_send/agent_stop address it by unique name; subagents keep running if the user interrupts; write subagents should use non-overlapping scopes.

sources.title: Coordinator and subagent runtime
sources.locator: internal/agent/coordinator.go dispatched map, runReport, reconciled, effectiveToolNames
sources.finding: Coordinator tracks detached subagents per parent session, folds reports into turns, reconciles unanswered dispatches as interrupted after restart; blocking subagent calls move to background after 60s; tool events fire only for the top-level agent.

sources.title: Permission service
sources.finding: Per-tool-call prompts with allow, allow-for-session and deny; permission modes include yolo (never prompts, refuses dangerous commands); subagents inherit session auto-approval.

sources.title: Crush hooks guide
sources.locator: docs/hooks/README.md Events table and Execution model
sources.finding: 13 hook events (PreToolUse can allow/deny/rewrite, PostToolUse, TurnStart/End, SessionStart/End, PreCompact...) running user shell commands; Claude Code compatible payloads; hooks fire for the top-level agent only.

sources.title: crush stats command
sources.finding: Usage statistics by day, model, hour, weekday, tool, with total tokens and cost across sessions or all known projects; renders an HTML report.

sources.title: Session model
sources.finding: SQLite-backed session with ParentSessionID, token counts, Cost, Todos, Channel; task sessions for subagents.

sources.title: Telemetry events
sources.finding: PostHog events: app initialized/exited, session created/deleted, prompt sent/responded, tokens used, stats viewed; pseudonymous device hash.

sources.title: Bash tool prompt (git commit and PR)
sources.finding: Prompt instructs the model to create commits with attribution trailers and PRs via gh pr create; no product-native PR object, only the bash tool and the gh CLI.

sources.title: Built-in tool set
sources.locator: internal/agent/tools/ directory (bash, edit, multiedit, write, view, ls, grep, glob, fetch, web_search, sourcegraph, lsp_*, todos, question, job_output, job_kill, MCP resource tools)
sources.finding: File, shell, search, LSP, web and MCP-resource tools; no dedicated git, PR, worktree, container or screenshot tool.

sources.title: MCP channel router
sources.finding: MCP servers opted in via --channels or channel_enabled can push messages that the server injects into exactly one session per workspace, even with no client attached; reply routing via channel_reply.

sources.title: Loop detection
sources.finding: Stops a run when a tool-call signature repeats more than 5 times in a 10-step window.

sources.title: Session agent run loop
sources.finding: Auto-summarizes when remaining context falls under a threshold unless disabled; per-step usage updates session tokens and cost (OpenRouter-reported or catalog pricing).

sources.title: Config structs and defaults
sources.locator: internal/config/config.go defaultContextPaths, Options (RequestTimeout default 60s, MaxBackgroundJobs default 50)
sources.finding: Reads AGENTS.md, CRUSH.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, copilot instructions as context; request timeout and background-job cap.

sources.title: MCP client package
sources.finding: MCP client with http, stdio and sse transports, per-server enable/disable, OAuth authorization-code flow, resources and prompts.

sources.title: Skill discovery
sources.locator: internal/skills/ and README Agent Skills section
sources.finding: Agent Skills standard: global and project skill directories (.agents/skills, .crush/skills, .claude/skills, .cursor/skills), user-invocable skills, disable list, built-in crush-config skill.

sources.title: LSP manager
sources.finding: LSP clients auto-discovered or configured with lsp add; tools expose definitions, references, symbols, rename, diagnostics.

sources.title: File version history
sources.finding: Stores per-session file versions (path, content, version) in SQLite for edited files.

sources.title: Local model discovery
sources.finding: Discovers local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, LiteLLM, oMLX) as providers.

sources.title: Crush v0.101.0 release
sources.finding: Skill toggles in the command palette, elapsed time on tool calls, CRUSH_DATA_DIR env var, yolo mode blocks dangerous commands, subagents no longer hang on permission prompts; Hyper requests compressed.

sources.title: Bounded search of the pinned release
sources.locator: rg -ci over internal/ (excluding tests), README.md, docs and AGENTS.md at v0.101.0
sources.finding: Search terms and hit counts (code/docs): git worktree|worktree add 2/0 (only a worktree-root lookup comment in internal/config/load.go:1429-1432, no creation); docker run|podman|bwrap|landlock|sandbox-exec 0/0; crontab 1 (a blocked-command name at internal/agent/tools/bash.go:140), no scheduler; webhook 1/0; linear.app|jira|github issue 0/1; vsix|vscode extension|jetbrains plugin 0/0; OTLP|opentelemetry 0/0; Authorization|Bearer in internal/server 0 (no server authentication); no spend_limit or turn-limit option beyond loop detection and request_timeout.

sources.finding: Bubble Tea TUI: chat, sidebar with session, model, cost, modified files with +/- counts, LSP and MCP status, session picker, command palette (ctrl+p), model picker (ctrl+l), permission dialogs with diffs.

sources.title: Crush README desktop notifications
sources.finding: Native or OSC/bell notifications when a tool call needs permission and when the agent finishes, only while the terminal is unfocused.

sources.finding: Homebrew, npm, Arch, Nix, FreeBSD, winget, scoop, apt, yum, release binaries (Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD) and go install.
